description:
Browse by conditions when you have no name. Questions like 'camping YouTubers who posted a new video recently' or 'hotels in 서귀포' cannot be answered by thea_search. Each filter multiplies: more filters, narrower list; subject alone is broad.
Rules:
1. If the question names an area, always pass inside. Without it the results are nationwide.
2. subject 920 (restaurants) also returns companies that run restaurants. Add category=장소 to get shops only.
3. For choosing questions ('best places', 'a good hotel') add sort=rating.
4. For news or recent periods ('yesterday's news', 'since August') pass since, plus inside if an area is named. For all news use since alone; to narrow to one field (e.g. entertainment 700, sports 1000) add subject. Never refuse a date as future.
5. Never repeat a call with the same arguments. If you got results, answer with them.
6. Each result has an id (a record also has its parent). To go deeper call thea_entry with that id; never search the name again.

category.description: Exact Korean values, comma-separated: 인물, 단체, 작품, 장소, 사건, 제품, 게임. Restaurants, cafes and lodging are subject codes, not categories.

country.description: Country (Japan or 일본). Pass it for places outside Korea.

cuisine.description: Restaurant type: an exact value (치킨, 중국집, 횟집 … https://thealibrary.org/static/cuisines.json), an everyday word (중식, 고깃집, 술집, 초밥 …), or a dish name (갈비찜, 물회), which also searches menus. Matches the registered type, not the name; about 19% of restaurants have no type.

field.description: key=value, joined with ';' (value * = any). e.g. girl groups: category=단체, field=group_type=걸그룹; ballad singers: category=인물, field=genre=발라드. Keys: 인물 gender, occupation, nationality, activity, topic; 단체 org_type, group_type, listed_on, sport, league; 작품 medium, genre, hashtags, serialization_status, rating; 게임 genre, hashtags, platform, age_rating, business_model; 장소 place_type, cuisine, featured_in, lodging_type, amenities … all keys/values: https://thealibrary.org/static/filters.json. A wrong key returns the allowed list.

inside.description: Area to search inside: an id from thea_search (best; names repeat, e.g. 중구), the official Korean name even in English questions (서귀포시, 명일동), or abroad an ISO 3166-2 code (JP-13). If ambiguous you get ids back; call again with one. With category=인물 it also matches birthplace; trust only born_here=true. If the question names an area, always pass it.

name.description: Words the name (or alias, English name) contains, in order, e.g. 'ikan bakar'. Use for partial names; thea_search needs the full name. With since it also searches record summaries.

pet.description: y = pets allowed, n = not. Copy each place's conditions (weight limit, cage) from 방문 정보 as written.

since.description: Records dated on or after YYYY-MM-DD. Thea has records newer than your training data; never refuse a date as future. Only dated records (releases, news, awards) match. Past results come newest first; scheduled ones are in upcoming (not yet happened).

sort.description: Use for 'best/good' questions. rating: well-rated first, many 별로예요 last. Each result shows 좋아요/보통/별로예요 counts; mention when counts are small.

subject.description: Subject code; a parent includes its children (1200 Travel includes 1210 lodging, 1240 camping). Top level: 100 Humanities, 200 History, 300 Society, 400 Science, 500 Technology, 600 Industry & Business, 700 Content & Arts, 800 Internet & Media, 900 Everyday Life, 1000 Sports, 1100 Automotive & Mobility, 1200 Travel & Leisure, 1300 Geography & Regions. Full table: https://thealibrary.org/static/subjects.json

title: Find in a Thea region
